scope: Published league-phase participants and pots. Match pairings and coefficients are fictional career simulations. Future participants come from career qualification.
openingPerformanceScope: The opening career begins after the published qualifiers. Performance places use points from career matches and the full admitted denominator; qualifying points from before the career are not invented. Recurring editions include all played qualifiers.
poolScope: Real clubs from UEFA’s published 2026/27 access list, including qualifying entrants. Foreign domestic results are career simulations among the available clubs.
